sources.ofsted_mi: Ofsted, Management information: state-funded schools, latest inspections as at 31 October 2026 (sha256 791eea96966d6a2de0a50687abd9ea74fd3fa32be6396c8c56ea7bf0f111d53f)
sources.sen: DfE, Special educational needs in England, school level data, January 2026 census, published 11 June 2026 (sha256 a339a409b811099bd200e09ddb3bcd7f9dffb2aa989297f1f27de8e4a749d653)
sources.gias: DfE, Get Information about Schools, daily extract 25 November 2026 (urban/rural fallback)
sources.ks4: Explorer data/raw/ks4_model_v3.csv: DfE KS4 performance 2024/25 final and 2025/26 provisional (28 October 2026); open replica of the similar-schools model
sources.daily: Report cards read from Ofsted reports published 2 to 23 November 2026 (data/raw/reports_daily.csv), sensitivity only

meta.outcome: Area graded Needs attention or Urgent improvement (below Expected standard)
meta.estimate: Average marginal effect, IDACI fifth 5 (most deprived) vs 1 (least), percentage points, 95% CI, HC1 robust SEs, delta method
meta.materiality: abs(AME) >= 5 pp and 95% CI excludes zero

safeguarding.note: Descriptive only; not broken down by phase or context because counts are under 10.
